# 7-Day Family Adventure in Tokyo

This relaxed itinerary balances high-energy anime culture with serene Shinto traditions, optimized for a family with an 8-year-old child.

## Recommended Neighborhoods for Families
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/2/25/Tokyo_Tower_and_Zojo-ji_Temple.jpg/1200px-Tokyo_Tower_and_Zojo-ji_Temple.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/house.svg
- **Azabu-Juban (Minato)**: International feel, very safe, and extremely quiet at night. Excellent local playgrounds and bakeries.
- **Kichijoji (Musashino)**: Consistently voted the most desirable place to live. Home to Inokashira Park and a very relaxed, kid-friendly vibe.

## Weekly Itinerary & Highlights

Day 1-2: Anime & Parks
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/0/07/Ghibli_Museum_Totoro.jpg/1200px-Ghibli_Museum_Totoro.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/tree.svg
- **Morning**: Ghibli Museum (Kichijoji). Magical world for children and adults. Entry: ¥2,000.
- **Afternoon**: Inokashira Park. Swan boat rentals and a small zoo. Entry: ¥1,200.

Day 3-4: Tradition & Street Food
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/6/6c/Senso-ji_Temple_Asakusa_Tokyo.jpg/1200px-Senso-ji_Temple_Asakusa_Tokyo.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning**: Senso-ji Temple (Asakusa). Tokyo's oldest temple with a festive atmosphere. Free.
- **Afternoon**: Nakamise-dori Street Food. Try fresh melon pan and fried mochi. Cost: ¥3,500.

Day 5-7: Modern Tokyo & Shrines
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/b/b1/Meiji_Jingu_Inner_Forest.jpg/1200px-Meiji_Jingu_Inner_Forest.jpg Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning**: Meiji Jingu Shrine. A peaceful forest in the heart of the city. Free.
- **Afternoon**: Harajuku & Takeshita Street. Colorful shops and giant crepes. Cost: ¥5,000.

## Estimated 7-Day Family Budget (USD)

Category | Estimated Cost | Notes
Food | $1,800 | $250/day average for 3 people
Local Transport | $350 | Suica cards & local trains
Entrance Fees | $450 | Ghibli, Zoo, and small attractions
Accommodation | $2,000 | Mid-range family hotel/apartment
Total | $4,600 | **$400 under budget**
